findings.description: When ledger.record raises ValueError (e.g., due to a memo longer than 40 characters), the transfer function has already modified the account balances. The contract requires that in this case, both the accounts dictionary and the ledger remain unchanged.
findings.evidence: Lines 18-20 perform `accounts[src] -= amount` and `accounts[dst] += amount` before calling `ledger.record`. If `ledger.record` fails, these changes are not undone, resulting in an inconsistent state.

review.summary: Transfer modifies accounts before recording ledger entry, violating the contract that both accounts and ledger remain unchanged if ledger.record raises an exception.
